classification.difficultyReason: Identify two alternate-segment angles in a circle with an extended chord.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Circle with a horizontal tangent at its top contact point; an inscribed triangle has an upper-left vertex and a lower-right vertex. Their connecting chord extends upwards left to the tangent. Ordinary source colours are replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: The tangent–chord angle on the left is 49 degrees and subtends the lower-right interior angle y. The tangent–chord angle on the right is 75 degrees and subtends the upper-left interior angle x. Coordinates derive from these given tangent–chord angles; construction point names are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 49-degree and 75-degree angles and the unknown labels x and y are visible. Printed source answers are omitted from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}x&=75^\circ\\y&=49^\circ\end{aligned}$$
Each angle equals the angle between the tangent and its corresponding chord, by the alternate segment theorem.
